thread:
maria: FYI — after the IdP TLS cert rotation pushed ~16:10 UTC we started seeing intermittent SAML failures and SCIM webhooks returning 500s. Spike in login errors ~30% of attempts. Rolling back cert now.

sre-bot: ALERT: sso-prod error-rate increased 4x at 16:14 UTC — alert id sso-2026-03-21-01.

devon: Can you paste the proxy logs? curious if it's a handshake issue vs assertion validation.

maria: Logs from sso-proxy (excerpt):
```
2026-03-21T16:12:34Z sso-proxy ERROR tls: handshake failure from 10.12.0.45: remote error: tls: bad certificate
2026-03-21T16:12:34Z sso-proxy WARN assertion verification passed but audience != expected (got: urn:sp:staging, want: urn:sp:prod)
```

jake: SCIM-service is also noisy: seeing KMS decrypt errors for stored webhook secrets which then fail auth back to IdP. Example: `error decrypting secret: InvalidCiphertextException: ciphertext contains unknown header`

priya: Did anyone change the group->role mapping or SP entityID recently? We merged a mapping rewrite at 15:50 that normalized NameID -> email. Could that change the SP audience or NameID format?

maria: Yes we rolled a small config change to RBAC mapping at 15:50 (PR #4123) — it touched the SAML assertion mapping and switched audience lookup logic to use `sp.entity_id` first. I didn't think it would affect cert rotation but timeline lines up.

devon: Two parallel suspects: 1) cert rotation produced a partial rollout so some proxy nodes still advertising old cert -> TLS handshake mismatch, 2) RBAC mapping change altered expected audience or NameID which made assertions fail against some SPs. Also KMS key alias for prod might have been switched, explaining the webhook secret decrypt errors.

sre-bot: CI/CD job idp-cert-rotate completed at 16:09 UTC across 3 clusters; rollout status shows 4/6 pods updated, 2 still on old cert at 16:11 UTC.

oncall-bot: Runbook step: if >20% login errors after cert rotation -> rollback rotation and revert recent mapping change.

maria: Executing rollback of cert rotation now (running): `kubectl -n sso rollout undo deployment/idp-proxy --to-revision=42`

jake: I'm also reverting the RBAC mapping change in staging and will promote revert to prod after cert rollback is confirmed.

priya: Quick check on KMS: `aws kms list-aliases --profile prod | grep sp-webhooks` shows alias `alias/sp-webhooks-prod` points to key id arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd-legacy` — we expected `key/abcd-2026-rotate`. Looks like key alias was repointed earlier today by infra-automation. That would produce the decrypt mismatch for older ciphertexts.

devon: Good catch. If alias was repointed, older webhook secrets encrypted under old key will fail until we rewrap or restore the old key alias target.

maria: Rollback completed for idp-proxy at 16:18 UTC, pods now back on previous cert (status green). Reverting RBAC mapping now.

jake: Revert PR merged and promoted at 16:21 UTC. SCIM worker restarted to pick up old mapping.

sre-bot: METRICS: sso-prod 5xx rate fell from 18% -> 2% at 16:25 UTC. Latency back to baseline.

maria: Verified end-to-end: users can login, SCIM webhooks are successful again. We still have KMS alias inconsistency; will coordinate with infra to either re-point alias back or rewrap secrets.

priya: Filing follow-up actions: 1) postmortem with timeline and decision to rollback, 2) add a KMS pre-rotation step to rewrap or stage re-encryption for stored secrets, 3) block RBAC mapping pushes during cert rotations, 4) add an IdP rollout healthcheck gating on assert-audience and TLS handshake checks.

devon: Also recommend adding a short-lived canary bucket: target 2 pods for early cert rotation and run SAML end-to-end checks against multiple SPs before full rollout.

maria: Agreed. Opening postmortem ticket and scheduling a quick sync with infra and identity teams. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Incident resolved and acknowledged. Please follow runbook for postmortem template.
